note: Fayette County TX (48149): no county zoning layer found in ArcGIS Online/Hub or on county sites; Texas counties generally do not zone. Cities publish zoning only as PDF maps: La Grange (2013 zoning map PDF, no GIS service), Schulenburg (2018 zoning map PDF drafted from a GIS file, no public service), Flatonia (zoning map linked, no service found). Fayette CAD GIS download is a parcel/ownership shapefile bundle with no zoning districts evident. No queryable zoning polygon service is published.
